title: Align icons with text
html:
<!-- vertical-align:baseline -->
<button type="button" id="context" class="font-size-md leading-lg"><svg id="target" class="display:inline-block width:32px height:32px vertical-align:baseline" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 5h16v14H4zM8 9h8M8 13h5" /></svg> Layers</button>

<!-- vertical-align:middle -->
<button type="button" id="context" class="font-size-md leading-lg"><svg id="target" class="display:inline-block width:32px height:32px vertical-align:middle" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 5h16v14H4zM8 9h8M8 13h5" /></svg> Layers</button>
